items.title: Model release: run audit-instructions (any release) + unhobble (frontier only) over this repo

precondition.prompt: A Claude model release of any class (frontier, Opus, Sonnet or Haiku) must have occurred since last_checked. audit-instructions runs on any release; unhobble runs only when the release is a frontier model. If no release has occurred, unclaim and leave the standing item open; never recheck-close on cadence alone.

items.notes: On each Claude model release (primary trigger), re-test which standing instructions the new model still needs over this repository's session surfaces. /harness-config:audit-instructions runs on any release (frontier, Opus, Sonnet or Haiku). /harness-config:unhobble runs only on a frontier release. The id names only the frontier case for history; the precondition prompt sets the release class. No automation observes the release event: the trigger's consumer is the standing OPEN [Maintenance] issue #2019, kept open continuously so /work-items:work can select it the moment an operator or agent notices a release, ahead of next_due. The quarterly cadence is a backstop only, guaranteeing the pass happens even when a release goes unnoticed (docs/plugin-philosophy.md, Instruction economy). Tier-4 caveat (known limitation, unenforced): last-resort selection can pick the open issue when no release has occurred, and neither the work skill's tier-4 step nor recheck's close step consults any precondition; the issue body instructs the claimant (no release since last_checked: unclaim, leave open, never recheck-close), but honoring that depends on the claimant reading the body and deviating from the unconditional close step. If a premature close drains the item before a real release, re-open or re-create it from this row. Session surfaces only, never the shipped plugin components. 2026-10-10: Claude Haiku 5.5 (not a frontier release) got the audit-instructions pass only; its findings are on #2019.

items.title: Listing-budget watch: report the shared aggregate and drift
items.notes: Report-only self-maintenance routine (digest menu #9 pilot). Run skill-quality's check-listing-budget.sh pooled over plugins/*/skills from a current main checkout; record aggregate, skill count, delta vs prior cycle, and top-10 contributors on the open [Maintenance] issue (#2023 is the first instance). Baseline and the pending target decision live in #2022. Never edits descriptions — findings route to issues.

items.title: Stale-doc drift watch: report doc references that no longer hold
items.notes: Report-only self-maintenance routine (digest menu #9 pilot). Sweep docs/ and top-level repo docs for references to files/checks/skills that no longer exist, stale version claims, and moved official-docs.md pages (review:doc-drift-detector or docs-hygiene audits); verify generated CATALOG/skill-cheat-sheet freshness on a scratch branch. File one issue per confirmed drift cluster or comment no-drift on the open [Maintenance] issue (#2024 is the first instance). Never edits docs directly from the routine.

items.title: Run /instruction-placement:migrate cutover-check
items.notes: Run /instruction-placement:migrate cutover-check; the skill defines the graded conditions and prints the evidence for each. Also run it, independent of cadence, whenever /harness-ops:changelog reports a Claude Code release that touches AGENTS.md handling or instruction-file loading. Comment each run's per-condition output on the open [Maintenance] issue (#4281). When every condition reports met, shim removal (remove-shims, per repo, human-confirmed) is unblocked and this row can be retired. Standing refresh 2026-09-28 12:31 UTC re-graded the nine readable repositories: conditions 1, 2, and 4 [MET], condition 3 [UNREACH] (claude auth status loggedIn false; both canary legs exited 1). last_checked stays 2026-09-20 until every graded condition is [MET]. Do not close #4281 from a partial grade.

items.title: Check actionlint for a release that parses uses: $/...
items.notes: Check rhysd/actionlint releases after v1.7.12 (and actionlint issues #711/#732) for one that parses uses: $/... . None: comment unmet on the [Maintenance] issue, change nothing. One: file an issue to repin the ci-workflows actionlint action (pr-require-checks.yml), re-count the zizmor: ignore[self-repository] sites (137 on 2026-10-24), run zizmor --fix=safe --persona=regular -- ., delete every zizmor: ignore[self-repository] and the comment above the Run zizmor step in pr-require-checks.yml; accept when zizmor and actionlint both exit 0, never a repo-wide disable. Spec: #4130.

items.title: Check the model-config fallback targets against the model-adaptation chapters
items.notes: Re-read https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#automatic-model-fallback. If it still names Opus 5, Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5, change nothing. For each model no longer named, file an issue: remove plugins/playbooks/reference/model-adaptation/<model>.md, update fable-5 meta-rule 3 with the new read date, fable-5 evals, playbooks CHANGELOG and version, then sweep stale references (spec: #4349). Retire the row when the opus-5, opus-4-8 and sonnet-5 chapters are gone.

items.title: Measure CI performance against the p50 and p95 targets
items.notes: Run github-iac eng/ci-perf snapshot.sh capture/compare read-only with --raw-root under .work/; append the scored rows to github-iac eng/ci-perf/GOAL.md's Run log; file an issue per row over target (targets p50 5 min, p95 12 min). Spec: #3932.

items.title: Check pr-verify verdicts lost to permission denials
items.notes: Run gh run list -R melodic-software/claude-code-plugins --workflow pr-verify.yml --branch main --status failure -L 50 and read each failed run's log for ::error::no verdict: the run hit N permission denial(s) or ::error::no verdict: the run's legs hit N permission denial(s) (write-verdict.mjs); list the lane PRs the merge lane refused verify:missing behind those heads. A person decides, per denial, whether it was a benign read (the model reaching for a path outside pr-verify-data) or injected PR text. Injected PR text: the refusal worked; keep it and change nothing. Benign reads recurring (2 or more lane PRs refused verify:missing from benign-read denials in 30 days): file a fix issue, trying first an automatic pr-require-checks rerun on the stalled head, since it leaves the injection refusal intact, then a tighter prompt. Below that: comment the counts on the [Maintenance] issue and change nothing. Rejected for now (#8432): a fail verdict with the reason, which refuses that head verify:fail, holds the PR's later heads verify:earlier-fail until a later pass on a different change clears them, and counts toward the verify:repeated-fail cap; and ignoring denials, which lets an injected read still be judged. Spec: #8432.
